trait declaration.description: Declare a trait (ctc expands it into a <Name>_vtbl struct)

struct using traits.description: Declare a struct plus a use clause (comma-separate several traits)

trait implementation.description: Implement a trait for a struct (self is the implicit receiver)

implemented method.description: A method inside an impl block; the first parameter becomes void *self

method call.description: Trait method call (ctc turns it into vptr dispatch with &obj)
